map.生殖激素与生精评估器 使用指南: Reproductive Hormone and Spermatogenesis Evaluator User Guide
map.录入男性 FSH、LH、E2、睾酮 T、PRL 等生殖激素水平，工具对照参考范围: Enter a man's FSH, LH, E2, testosterone T, PRL and other reproductive hormone levels, and the tool assesses the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis against the reference ranges to judge the type of spermatogenic failure (central or testicular), assisting the initial screening of male infertility.
map.FSH/LH/E2/T/PRL 联合分析。: Combined reading of FSH, LH, E2, T and PRL.
map.高泌乳素/高雄鉴别。: Differential diagnosis of high prolactin and high testosterone.
map.：FSH 升高伴 E2 不低 → 卵巢储备减退（DOR）倾向，建议 AMH 与: Elevated FSH with E2 not low points to diminished ovarian reserve (DOR); confirm with AMH and AFC.
map.：泌乳素显著升高（正常<25） → 高泌乳素血症，抑制排卵，需查垂体 MRI。: Prolactin markedly elevated (normal <25) → hyperprolactinaemia, which suppresses ovulation; a pituitary MRI is needed.
map.卵泡期 FSH>10 提示储备下降、>20 明显减退、>25 反应极差。: A follicular phase FSH>10 suggests reduced reserve, >20 clear decline and >25 a very poor response.
map.PCOS 常 LH/FSH≥2 伴 T 升高；需结合超声。: PCOS often shows LH/FSH ≥ 2 with elevated T; it has to be combined with ultrasound.
